title: On the Sanctity of Children
summary: A former resident of a children's home is found stabbed to death.
method: The killer wanted to give the impression that they were covering up for someone else. They stabbed the victim, hid the knife, and picked up another knife on the ground, knowing that it didn't match the wound. They then ran away, threw the knife onto a moving truck, and turned back to be caught by the police.
motive: The killer was in a relationship with the victim when he was a teenager in the care home, and she was one of his carers. The victim had gone to therapy to cope with this relationship and it seemed like he was at a breaking point where he would reveal it, which would damage the reputation of the killer.
killer: One of the carers in the childrens' home
